u0: No outstanding obligation: the box is in hand or the situation is otherwise settled, and the agent still needs to get the box and reach the exit while carrying it. From here the agent can move toward the goal or wait, as long as a fall is answered immediately and any arrival at the exit is made with the box in hand.
u1: The box has just slipped from the agent's hands, so the immediate obligation is to pick it up again on this very step. Holding the box again restores the settled situation and clears the requirement; failing to have it in hand on the next step is an unrecoverable violation. If instead the agent arrives at the exit on that step, it must already be carrying the box, otherwise the run fails.
u2: The agent stands on the exit on a step when the box did not fall, but the box is not in hand, so the arrival does not satisfy the requirement. The next step must put the box in hand to fulfill the obligation and clear it, and this must happen without arriving at the exit again empty-handed. Any further step without the box in hand, or any arrival at the exit without it, is an unrecoverable violation.
u3: The agent reached the exit on a step when the box also slipped from its hands, leaving both obligations open at once. The very next step must put the box in hand to discharge them; after that the agent returns to a settled situation, though it will still have to get back to the exit carrying the box. Any subsequent step without the box in hand, or any empty-handed arrival at the exit, is an unrecoverable violation.
u4: A mandatory obligation was broken: after the box fell, or after arriving at the exit, the box was not picked up on the very next step, or the agent was at the exit without carrying the box. Successful completion is no longer possible, and any remaining steps only accrue penalty.
